description: JLine is a Java library for building interactive command-line applications with terminal abstraction, line editing, history, and completion support. The jline bundle packages the core JLine modules, including terminal, reader, builtins, console, style, and remote shell components.

skipped-versions.reason: Published jar for org.jline:jline:3.25.0 declares --features=org.fusesource.jansi.internal.NativeImageFeature in META-INF/native-image/jansi/native-image.properties, but no published jline or jansi jar contains that class, so every native-image build fails with 'User-enabled Feature ... class not found'; fixed upstream in 3.25.1, which drops the declaration.
